title: Maria Leptin | EMBO Science Journalism Fellowships
duration: Journalists: minimum three months, maximum six months. Researchers transitioning to journalism: minimum three months, maximum twelve months.
description: The Maria Leptin | EMBO Science Journalism Fellowships support science journalism by providing journalists with funded placements at research institutions to deepen and broaden their knowledge of the life and associated sciences, and researchers wishing to transition full time into journalism with funded placements in media newsrooms. The scheme was made possible by a private donation from Professor Maria Leptin.

title: UM NL Global Studies Scholarship
duration: 36 months (the full three-year Global Studies bachelor's programme)
description: Maastricht University awards one full-coverage scholarship per academic year to a bachelor student who has been admitted to its Global Studies bachelor's programme. For 2027-2028 the award covers tuition fees at cost plus a living-expense stipend of EUR 20,150 per academic year, and includes a mandatory two-week UM Pre-Academic Training in the first week of August 2027. Applications are open from 1 October 2026 to 1 February 2027, and the bachelor's programme application in Studielink must be complete by 10 December 2026.

title: Latvian State Scholarship for Foreign Students (Scholarship for Studies in Latvia)
duration: Up to 10 months for bachelor's and master's students; up to 11 months for doctoral students; maximum two terms within one study cycle
description: The Latvian state scholarship for studies pays a monthly stipend to students from more than 30 partner countries who are enrolled in a bachelor's, master's or doctoral programme at a Latvian higher education institution. It is worth EUR 500 per month for bachelor's and master's students and EUR 700 per month for doctoral students, awarded for up to 10 months (11 months for doctoral students). The annual call runs from 1 February to 1 April through the VIAA online application system, so the next window opens on 1 February 2027.

title: International Excellence Entrance Scholarship
duration: Entrance award for the first year of study
description: The University of Manitoba awards one International Excellence Entrance Scholarship valued at $25,000 and two valued at $10,000 each to international high school graduates entering University 1 or any faculty, college or school with a direct entry option. The $25,000 award requires a minimum admission average of 90% across five senior level high school courses, while the two $10,000 awards require only the minimum admission requirements for the programme. title: Killam Predoctoral Scholarship Level 2 (Doctoral)

description: The Faculty of Graduate Studies at Dalhousie University awards Killam Predoctoral Scholarships competitively to outstanding doctoral students across all disciplines, with a base value of $42,000 per year ($14,000 per term) for up to three years. title: Dalhousie Research Excellence Scholarship (DRES)
official_source: Dalhousie University, Faculty of Graduate Studies
duration: Up to 48 months, and not past the end of the fourth year in the programme
description: Established in 2024, the Dalhousie Research Excellence Scholarship attracts and supports exceptional new PhD students at Dalhousie University and is valued at $35,000 per year for up to four years. Of the total, $28,000 is provided by Graduate Studies and the remaining $7,000 by the supervisor and/or programme of study. Applicants must intend to start a PhD at Dalhousie between January 2027 and January 2028, and funds are only administered after admission to and registration in the intended programme. title: National Humanities Center Residential Fellowship
degree: PhD (terminal degree required; postdoctoral researchers and doctoral candidates are not eligible)
program_type: Independent humanities institute research fellowship (private nonprofit)
duration: Academic year (September-May), or fall semester (September-December) or spring semester (January-May)
description: The National Humanities Center is a private, nonprofit organization and the only independent institute dedicated exclusively to advanced study in all areas of the humanities. Its Residential Fellowship offers scholars the time, space and support to pursue their work and the opportunity to take part in the Center's intellectual community.
